dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent with sharp, high-contrast pale edges defining the boundaries of individual primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: An irregular, high-contrast white patch on the lateral neck/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Clearly visible transition where the fine, dense patterning of the crown meets the larger-scaled feather patterns of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, robust bill with a pale base and dark tip; prominent white plumage patch on the side of the head/neck.
